home.home_text:
Hello, my name is Weuller. Welcome to my portfolio! Here you will find information about my professional and academic journey in the world of development.

To get to know me better, I will share a bit about my experience. Currently, I am {{age}} years old and have been studying development for about five years. I started my formation in 2020 at the Federal Institute of Goiás (IFG), where I had my first contact with the field through solving basic algorithmic problems.

In 2021, I was introduced to web development, a field that I imagined to be completely different until then. Since then, I have been specializing in creating applications. In 2024, I began preparing for the AWS CLF-C02 certification. As part of the learning process, I deployed a Linux EC2 server on AWS and put a website online — a valuable experience, even if the project is no longer active. In the same year, I successfully obtained the certification.

This portfolio reflects my growth and dedication to the field. Feel free to explore my projects and learn more about my work!

experience.exp_description: Here are some experiences I have gained in the job market.

exp_card.descricao: At Compass, I worked on developing an e-commerce system, using React with TypeScript to build the interface. I implemented unit tests with Jest to ensure code quality and used Tailwind CSS for agile and responsive styling. During the application deployment, I configured an EC2 instance with Apache for hosting in the AWS cloud, in addition to integrating an S3 bucket for storing project images. My experience combines modern front-end development with cloud computing practices, always seeking efficient and scalable solutions.

I work at Telefônica (Vivo) developing interfaces for the application using React, contributing to the creation of layouts and the continuous improvement of the user experience. I implement unit tests using Jest, component tests with Cypress, and mutation tests with Stryker, ensuring code quality, reliability, and stability. I also participate in the creation of new screens and the maintenance of existing features, working on bug fixes and improvements in performance and usability.
